value.confidence_rule: A 100% letter-for-letter match equals confidence 10 (100%). If one to three letters are off, and those differences are likely suffixes "ing", "ion", "ed", or "er", confidence remains high at 80–85%. After that, confidence of 75% or lower is unacceptable and results in writing unresolved domain. A confidence at or below 0.75 writes unresolved domain.
value.method: versioned local associative lexicon; no LLM calls; ranked multi-label evidence; if unresolvable, write unresolved domain; no forced symbol
value.rule_module: The actual rules for domain decisions will be an extensive module needing expansion, and will be an entire evening of work one day. For now, the current rule and lists will suffice. If unresolvable, write unresolved domain.
value.scoring_rubric: The professional TLD list at https://tld-list.com/tld-categories/professional is primary. If a domain exists on that list, it is domain-specific and tied to that .domain extension; a host of websites therefore exist from which terminology and structures can be extracted easily. If the domain is not part of the professional domain list, fall back to the attached NYCH taxonomy lexicon committed at icm/MG8PK/lexicons/nych-professional-domain-taxonomy.md. That lexicon will be updated with every proper NYCH update.

value.tie_policy: In the strange case of matching — a tie, when two or more domains receive the same score — include both (or all tied domains) and do not prune either domain. Instead use both as possible root domains and reason within both.
